note: The requests of the showcase of Bãi Trước to World (plan 0026, D5 and section 7). The kinds: "rule" (an order of a blueprint that World has: World can build it now), "drawing" (an order of the blueprint drawing: World can build it now), "new_rule" (World has no rule for it yet: "needs" says what the rule must give), "world_plan" (a step of a plan of World), and "answer" (an answer to a question of World). A source with an open license can go to World with its credit; another source is a reference only. tools/world/world_requests.py checks the file, and with --check it asks check_order of World for each order. The year of each model is 2019 (Q-W1).

requests.what: The year of each model of Vũng Tàu is 2019.
requests.to: World plan 0018, section 6 ("The year of the model")
requests.answer: 2019 for each model of this game. A building that stood in 2019 and is gone now stays (for example the villas of OSC Việt Nam at number 40); the hotel in construction at number 40 (2024) is not in the game. A look that only a photo from before 2017 or after 2021 shows has the status Check, and the owner decides it.

requests.what: Khách sạn Hải Âu (124 Hạ Long, OSM way 790529523), in front of the jetty of Cầu Đá.

options.name: khach_san_hai_au
sources: The plan is the outline of OpenStreetMap way 790529523 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL): 70.9 m along Hạ Long and 21.3 m deep. Side 1 faces the sea and Hạ Long. The sides 1, 8, 11, 20, and 22 face the sea; the others are the ends of the wings and the back.

The look is from two photos of Wikimedia Commons: trungydang, 2014-04-05, CC BY 3.0 (sky blue with white bands), and HappyMidnight, 2010-11-20, CC BY-SA 4.0 (white with light green panels). The color of 2019 is not known: this request uses the color of 2014.
A guess: 5 storeys for all the building (the photos show wings of 4 to 6 storeys; a hotel page says 6), the storey height, and the bays.

sources.author: trungydang
sources.shows: The front from Hạ Long: sky blue walls with white bands, a block of 5 storeys, a tower with the letters HAI AU, a wing of 4 storeys with a glass ground storey, flat roofs.

sources.author: HappyMidnight
sources.shows: The front from the jetty: white walls with light green panels, wings of 4 to 6 storeys with long balconies, flat roofs, the tower with the letters.

sources.author: Tuong Lam Photos
sources.shows: Hạ Long and the jetty of Cầu Đá from a drone, with the boats of the bay.

requests.status: Check: the storeys and the color in 2019 (plan 0026, Q1). The name is a landmark that the owner approved if the hotel stood in 2019 (culture notes).

requests.what: The things of the park of Bãi Trước: the pavilion with the orange tile roof, a bench, a low lamp, the blue lamp pole with a curved arm, the green post with globes, a kiosk, and the sculptures.
requests.needs: A street kit of the park (plan 0023, W21): each thing as a model with its sizes and its roles (concrete, granite, paint, glass, tile). The sculptures wait: the park had 41 granite sculptures from 2006, and which stood in 2019 is not known (Q2). The catalog of World has den_duong (a street lamp of 8 m with an LED head), but not the lamps of these photos.

sources.author: trungydang
sources.shows: Blue lamp poles with a curved arm, and green posts with globes on the sea side of Hạ Long.

sources.author: trungydang
sources.shows: The pavilion with the orange roof in the park (plan 0026, section 3; not looked at for this request).

requests.status: Check: the place of the pavilion, the kiosks, and the sculptures in 2019 (plan 0026, Q2).

requests.what: People of 2019: the clothes of a town in 2019 and a swim ring (phao).
requests.needs: The person blueprint has a T-shirt (world_t_shirt), a shirt (elvs_male_shirt_untucked_bd1), shorts (elvs_male_trouser_short_1, world_quan_dui), long pants (world_pants), sandals (elvs_male_flip_flop_sandals1, elvs_caesar_sandals1), and the nón lá (hat non_la). It does not have: a dress, áo bà ba, a sun jacket with a hood for a ride, swim clothes, a helmet on a person who stands or walks, and a swim ring (a ring of rubber in a bright color, or the tube of a truck tire, that a person holds or sits in). Also, the factory cannot build the near level of a person now (HTTP 503: "the order needs more memory than the edge has", 2026-11-16), so it cannot make its receipt.
requests.status: The order shows the clothes that World has now.

requests.what: The Araucaria (Norfolk pine), a hedge, and the plants of a flower bed, with the plant blueprint.
requests.needs: Species for the plant blueprint (it has areca, bamboo, banana, coconut, and frangipani): Araucaria heterophylla (layers of flat branches on a straight trunk, up to 20 m), a clipped hedge (a block of small leaves of a length and a height), and the low plants of a flower bed in yellow and red.
